All eight small-family quotient formulas now have compiled adapters to the actual source polynomials. The first low-cone residual equivalence also compiled. A combined kernel replay timed out, so I’m replaying smaller groups over compiled imports and retaining the timeout receipt. The final validation inventory will distinguish those checks.

The compiled results remain partial. The extra replay checks are slower than compilation and have timed out on certificate groups. I’m now validating the source-level theorems and residual equivalences over their compiled imports, and will flag the unfinished dependency replay. Full Conjecture 6.3 remains unresolved.

The half-cone certificates have all compiled, and the final transport to raw coefficients is being checked. The earlier twenty source and quotient modules passed kernel replay with only the permitted axioms. I’m finishing the residual equivalence and preservation manifest, while keeping the incomplete certificate-dependency replay explicit.

The half-cone source theorem and exact residual equivalence have compiled. They cover \(a\ge7\) with \(a\le2(b\bmod a)\), together with the inherited \(b<5a\) region. I’m completing the final audit and hash check. The report will keep `completion: null` and identify the missing dependency replay and independent completion audit.
